# ZETA RAYS — boot menu theme (GRUB). Used by the installation media (UEFI)
# and by the installed system (/usr/share/grub/themes/zeta), in the same
# style as the BIOS menu (isolinux): black, small logo, entries in a column,
# the selection marked by a slightly lighter band with a small blue bar on
# the left. No icons, no boxes, normal-size text (Roboto Medium 16/13,
# generated by tools/gen-grub-theme.sh).
# Positions are relative to the center: works from 1024x768 to 1920x1080
# (the resolution is the screen's native one, see config.cfg and hook 0100).
title-text: ""
desktop-color: "#000000"
terminal-font: "Unifont Regular 16"
message-font: "Roboto Medium Regular 13"
message-color: "#8A8A8E"

+ image {
        left = 50%-41
        top = 50%-218
        width = 82
        height = 86
        file = "logo.png"
}

+ label {
        top = 50%-124
        left = 0
        width = 100%
        height = 16
        align = "center"
        color = "#5A5A60"
        font = "Roboto Medium Regular 13"
        text = "OS 2.0"
}

+ boot_menu {
        left = 50%-220
        top = 50%-88
        width = 440
        height = 300
        item_font = "Roboto Medium Regular 16"
        item_color = "#8A8A8E"
        selected_item_font = "Roboto Medium Regular 16"
        selected_item_color = "#FFFFFF"
        item_height = 32
        item_padding = 0
        item_spacing = 4
        icon_width = 0
        icon_height = 0
        item_icon_space = 0
        selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
        scrollbar = false
}

+ label {
        id = "__timeout__"
        top = 100%-82
        left = 0
        width = 100%
        height = 16
        align = "center"
        color = "#6E6E73"
        font = "Roboto Medium Regular 13"
        text = "Starting automatically in %d s"
}

+ label {
        top = 100%-54
        left = 0
        width = 100%
        height = 16
        align = "center"
        color = "#4A4A50"
        font = "Roboto Medium Regular 13"
        text = "Up/Down  Select        Enter  Start        E  Edit        C  Command line"
}
